hook.say: True or false? Five facts about Europe, three seconds each. Wait for the border at the end!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Rome is farther north than New York City.
questions.fact: Rome sits at 41.9° north. New York City is at 40.7° north.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Rome sits more than 1 degree of latitude north of New York City.

questions.q: Great Britain and the United Kingdom are the same thing.
questions.fact: Great Britain is the island. The UK also includes Northern Ireland.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Great Britain is the island. The United Kingdom also includes Northern Ireland.

questions.q: Most of Iceland is covered in ice.
questions.fact: Glaciers cover only about 10% of Iceland.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Glaciers cover only about 10 percent of Iceland.

questions.q: Monaco is smaller than New York's Central Park.
questions.fact: Monaco covers 2.08 km². Central Park covers 3.41 km².
questions.sayAnswer: True! Monaco covers about 2 square kilometers. Central Park is over 3.

questions.q: France's longest land border is with Brazil.
questions.fact: French Guiana borders Brazil for 730 km. The border with Spain is 623 km.
questions.sayAnswer: True! French Guiana, part of France, borders Brazil for 730 kilometers.
